site.name: DevNotes
site.tagline: Deep, interview-focused tech notes: concepts, code, edge cases and quick revision.
site.description: Free, deep and interview-focused backend notes for Java developers: Core Java, Collections, Java 8, multithreading, design patterns, Spring Boot and SQL — with runnable code, diagrams and interview Q&A.

tracks.name: Java
tracks.description: Core Java fundamentals through modern Java features.

topics.name: Core Java
topics.description: OOP, SOLID, Object class, equality, Strings, immutability, wrappers, enums, records, sealed classes, var and pass-by-value.

topics.name: Collection Framework
topics.description: List, Set, Queue, Deque and Map implementations, HashMap internals, ConcurrentHashMap, load factor and fail-fast vs fail-safe iterators.

topics.name: Java 8 & Streams
topics.description: Streams from basics to internals: filter, map, sorting, reduce, collectors, groupingBy, flatMap, Optional, primitive streams, functional interfaces, method references, parallel streams, custom collectors, Spliterator and the java.time API.

topics.name: Exception Handling
topics.description: Checked vs unchecked, try-with-resources, custom exceptions, finally, suppressed exceptions, propagation, overriding rules, best practices and Spring Boot error handling.

topics.name: Reflection
topics.description: The Class class, obtaining Class objects, class loading internals, inspecting classes, constructors, fields and methods, annotations and dynamic proxies (JDK vs CGLIB).

topics.name: Multithreading
topics.description: Java concurrency from first principles to production: thread lifecycle, race conditions, synchronized, the Java Memory Model and volatile, wait/notify, deadlocks, explicit locks, atomics and CAS, executors and ThreadPoolExecutor sizing, CompletableFuture, synchronizers, concurrent collections, ThreadLocal, Fork/Join, virtual threads and Spring @Async.

tracks.name: Spring
tracks.description: Spring Core, Spring Boot, Data JPA and Security.

topics.name: Spring Boot
topics.description: Spring Boot annotations and internals: stereotypes, Spring MVC request handling, request/response binding, exception handling, validation, dependency injection, bean lifecycle, AOP, security, auto-configuration, Actuator, microservices, performance and configuration properties.

topics.name: Spring Data JPA & Hibernate
topics.description: Repositories and save() internals, derived query keywords, pagination and keyset scrolling, @Query and JPQL, native SQL, entity mapping and ID strategies, the persistence context and dirty checking, relationships and cascading, fetching and the N+1 problem, transactions, propagation and locking, projections, Specifications and auditing, inheritance and composite keys, second-level caching, HikariCP, Flyway migrations, testing with Testcontainers and advanced Hibernate features.

topics.name: Spring Security & JWT
topics.description: Securing Spring Boot REST APIs: password hashing with PasswordEncoder and BCrypt, JWT structure and signing algorithms, a complete JWT authentication filter and Spring Security 6 configuration, JJWT 0.12, refresh tokens, logout and the security pitfalls interviewers ask about.

topics.name: Logging (SLF4J & Log4j2)
topics.description: Production logging for Java and Spring Boot: SLF4J vs Logback vs Log4j2, log levels, log4j2.xml, rolling files and retention, PatternLayout, MDC request IDs, async and JSON logging, Actuator level changes and Log4Shell.

tracks.name: Design Patterns
tracks.description: Creational, structural, behavioral and microservices patterns with runnable Java code — and where Spring uses them.

topics.name: Essential Design Patterns
topics.description: Ten patterns every backend developer is asked about, with runnable Java code: Factory Method, Singleton, Builder, Strategy, Observer, Proxy, Adapter, Decorator, plus the microservices patterns Circuit Breaker and Saga — when to use each, look-alikes, and where Spring uses them.

tracks.name: Microservices
tracks.description: Messaging and event-driven architecture: Apache Kafka, service communication and resilience.

topics.name: Apache Kafka Masterclass
topics.description: Apache Kafka for Java backend developers, from fundamentals to production: topics, partitions and offsets, KRaft and replication, producers and consumers, offsets and rebalancing, exactly-once and the outbox pattern, retention and compaction, Spring Kafka, retries and dead-letter topics, Schema Registry, Kafka Streams and Connect, performance, monitoring, security and interview scenarios.

topics.name: Microservices Fundamentals
topics.description: Building microservices with Spring Boot and Spring Cloud: decomposition and DDD, inter-service communication, service discovery, API gateway, centralized configuration, Resilience4j, data management with sagas, outbox and CQRS, OAuth2 security, observability with tracing, Docker and Kubernetes deployment, and interview scenarios.

topics.name: SQL & MySQL
topics.description: MySQL for backend developers: fundamentals and architecture, CRUD, filtering, functions, NULLs, transactions and ACID, every kind of JOIN, grouping, subqueries, CTEs, window functions, keys and constraints, normalization, indexes, views, stored procedures, set operators and performance tuning.

tracks.name: System Design
tracks.description: Scalability, caching, queues and real-world architectures.

topics.name: System Design Basics
topics.description: System design for backend interviews and real systems: a step-by-step framework, estimation, scalability and availability, load balancing, caching and CDNs, SQL vs NoSQL, replication and sharding, CAP and consistency, queues, rate limiting, API design, and worked designs of a URL shortener and a notification system.

tracks.name: Real-World Scenarios
tracks.description: Production troubleshooting and scenario-based interview questions with full answers.

topics.name: Java Backend Production Scenarios
topics.description: 72 scenario-based interview questions with full answers: slow APIs and production incidents, connection pools and transactions, sagas and resilience, Kafka lag, duplicates and DLQs, idempotency and locking, OutOfMemoryError, GC, thread pools and deadlocks, Spring Boot pitfalls, JWT and authorization, replay protection and secrets management.
